description: Share the primary br workspace in Codex worktrees.

hooks.command: if ! br init --redirect >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"WARNING: br init --redirect failed. Ensure br is on PATH and rerun it here for details; use an exact .beads path when discovery fails, or after inspecting initialized local state explicitly run br redirect set /exact/path/to/.beads --allow-existing."}'; fi
